notes.title: Update 1.3.2. - Improved game visuals, new upgrade options and more!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42652737/f39f19a0ba963386db899eb2ac4cdc2d4d78e8ef.png[/img]This update contains following changes:
- new & improved in-game graphics
- added more upgrade options
- fixed bugs with abilities (e.g. airstrike not taking projectile bonus into account)
- small tweak & balance changes

If you want to request a feature, ask for help or give us a very much appreciated feedback, please jump to our [url=https://discord.com/invite/4nKgsfgwA8]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Added option to hide in-game image unlocks
notes.notes:
This patch adds a requested feature to hide the in-game unlocked images with a new setting in the main menu. Also includes a few minor tweaks to other things.

The save file should get automatically upgraded to include the new feature. If you wish to hide the in-game images simply check the checkbox in the main menu and it'll get remembered along with your save.

notes.title: Update 1.1.6 - Balance & Gameplay Improvements
notes.notes:
We just released a new version that fixes some of the problems, the biggest changes being:

- Powerups are easier to pick up in the beginning.
- Increased enemy spawn radius to make accidentally running into newly spawned enemies less frequent.
- Overall balance tweaks.
- Show info when a new big wave of enemies is spawned to better communicate level progression.

The overall balance should now allow more easily passing the first stage of the level, with the ending being slightly more difficult. This should allow learning the mechanics better without sacrificing replay value.

Accidentally running into enemies should now happen much less often as their spawn radius was increased during most of the game's stages.
